summary: Cylindrical planetary gearbox with a Ø36mm body on the z axis, a stepped front housing with a hole pattern, and an 8mm REX output shaft (7mm flat to flat). The rear face has a Ø13mm central opening and four Ø3mm holes on a 25mm pattern.

mountingSurfaces.description: Front gearbox face with the 4mm-hole pattern. Four holes at (±8, ±8) are 10mm deep and the top-center hole at (0, +12) is 6mm deep. The 8mm REX shaft projects 23.5mm from this face.
Rear face of the Ø36mm body, with four Ø3mm holes on a 25mm pattern and a Ø13mm central opening.

notes: Dimensions come from the printed drawing. The 32.7mm body length (including the 11.6mm front housing) plus the 23.5mm shaft gives a 56.2mm total z length. The bounding box is centered on the part, so the rear face is at z=-28.1, the front face at z=4.6 and the shaft tip at z=+28.1. The vendor's 24mm length is not used for the bounds because it conflicts with the 32.7mm drawing dimension. The front-face hole positions were scaled from the drawing: the 24mm and 16mm callouts indicate rows at y=±12 and y=±8, and the ±8 x-offset was estimated from the image. The bottom-center hole at (0, -12) is visible, but its depth is not stated, so it is not listed. The rear Ø3mm holes sit on a 25mm pattern at roughly 45°, which is assumed from the view. Whether the rear holes and the Ø13mm opening are through is not stated, so both are marked false.
